info.title: Stream API: Live (preview)
info.description: The Stream Live endpoints from the preview Stream API spec. Kept separate from stream.json, which tracks the public spec, until Live reaches it.

get.description: Returns live encoding seconds totals, a time-series chart (hourly or daily UTC), and breakdowns by live stream, codec, and resolution. Use hourly=true for hour buckets when the range falls within the last 30 days; older ranges automatically use daily buckets.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Optional start of the time range (UTC). If omitted, the last 14 days are returned.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Optional end of the time range (UTC). If omitted, the current date is used.

parameters.name: hourly
parameters.description: Optional. If true, returns hourly data when the range is within the last 30 days; otherwise daily (UTC). Default is daily.

parameters.name: liveStreamGuids
parameters.description: Optional live stream IDs to include. Repeat the query parameter for multiple values (max 50).

parameters.name: videoCodecs
parameters.description: Optional video codecs to include: H264, VP9, HEVC, AV1. Repeat for multiple values.

parameters.name: resolutions
parameters.description: Optional output heights to include: 240, 360, 480, 720, 1080, 1440, 2160. Repeat for multiple values.

200.description: Returns live encoding duration statistics for the requested video library.

400.description: The date range or filters are invalid.

404.description: The requested video library was not found.

503.description: ClickHouse live statistics are not available.

get.description: Gets details of a live stream contained in library by its ID.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The details of the requested live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

put.description: Updates the live stream object with the specified parameters and returns it. While the live stream is running only the title, description and scheduled end time can be updated

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The live stream was successfully updated

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

patch.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) to the live stream and returns it. An omitted property keeps its value and null removes it where the live stream allows that, for example the scheduled start or end time. While the live stream is running only the title, description and scheduled end time can be changed

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The live stream was successfully updated

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

delete.description: Deletes the live stream object and all resources associated with it. This operation cannot be undone.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The details of the requested live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

get.description: Returns playback URLs and player metadata for the live stream. For libraries with token authentication enabled, token and expires must be a valid signed pair or the request is rejected. If the library also has CDN token authentication enabled, the returned CDN URLs are signed.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Signed access token, required when the library has token authentication enabled.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the token is valid until, required when the library has token authentication enabled.

parameters.name: previewToken
parameters.description: Preview token from the preview access endpoint. Before the stream goes public, a valid token makes the response return the signed preview playlist. An invalid token is ignored.

parameters.name: previewExpires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the preview token is valid until.

200.description: The play data of the requested live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

get.description: Returns the signed playlist URL and player parameters that let the stream owner watch the stream before it goes public. The access lasts 10 hours or until the stream goes public, whichever comes first.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: Signed access for watching the live stream before it goes public

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

409.description: The live stream is already public or has finished, so it has no preview

post.description: Creates a new live stream object with the specified parameters and returns it

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

200.description: The live stream was successfully created and returned as the response.

402.description: The account is on the free trial and has not linked a payment card

429.description: The concurrent live stream limit was reached

404.description: The requested video library was not found.

get.description: Returns a list of streams associated with this library and collection, if passed. search matches the stream GUID or title, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to return, 1-based; values below 1 are treated as 1.

parameters.name: itemsPerPage
parameters.description: The number of items to return per page, clamped to a range of 10-1000.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filters streams by title or stream GUID, case-insensitive substring match.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field to order by. Possible values: date, title, status, started, ended, planned — any other value is rejected with 400

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Filters streams by collection ID.

200.description: The list of live streams associated with this library

404.description: The requested library was not found

get.description: Returns the RTMP, RTMPS and SRT ingest endpoints for publishing to the live stream given by liveStreamId, or, without liveStreamId, with the library's auto-create stream key. Append the stream key to the RTMP and RTMPS URLs; the SRT URLs already carry it. SRT is null when SRT ingest is not configured, when the library has no auto-create stream key, or for an auto-created live stream, which is published with the library's key. The auto-create endpoints are returned whether or not auto-create is turned on, and need the full API key.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: liveStreamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream. Leave it out for the library's auto-create stream key.

200.description: The ingest endpoints for the live stream, or for the library's auto-create stream key

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

put.description: Marks the stream as started, allowing viewers to view the stream.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The details of the started live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

503.description: The stream could not be started right now. The stream is unchanged and the request can be retried.

put.description: Stops the stream, if publishing is still ongoing, it will be stopped by the ingest server. If 'RecordVod' was set to true, the stream will be converted to a regular video as a VOD.This operation cannot be undone.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The details of the requested live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

put.description: Regenerates the stream key for the live stream. This operation is not allowed for streams that ended. If the stream is currently live, the active publishers (primary and backup) are disconnected within a few seconds and the previous key stops working. The stream is not ended: publish with the new key within the reconnect window to resume the same live stream, recording and DVR window. Other settings cannot be changed while the stream is live.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The details of the live stream with regenerated stream key

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

get.description: Returns recorded bitrate samples for the live stream, optionally constrained to a time range using startTime and endTime.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Filter bitrate samples recorded at or after this UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Filter bitrate samples recorded at or before this UTC timestamp.

200.description: The bitrate history for the requested live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

get.description: Returns the most recent bitrate sample for the live stream's primary ingest.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

404.description: The requested live stream was not found, or no bitrate sample is available yet

post.description: Sets the live stream's thumbnail. If thumbnailUrl is omitted, the thumbnail is read from the request body as a raw image upload. Otherwise, thumbnailUrl is fetched by the server as a URL, so it must point to a reachable, publicly accessible image.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

parameters.name: thumbnailUrl
parameters.description: Optional URL for the server to fetch the thumbnail from. Omit to upload a raw image in the request body instead.

400.description: The request or URL was invalid

404.description: The requested stream was not found

403.description: The thumbnailUrl was blocked by outbound URL validation, or the operation was rejected by a video/library restriction.

422.description: Unable to fetch thumbnail from origin

delete.description: Removes the custom thumbnail from the live stream. When restoreLibraryDefault is true and the library has a default live thumbnail set, the stream will use that instead of having no thumbnail.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

parameters.name: restoreLibraryDefault
parameters.description: When true and the library has a default live thumbnail, the stream will be set to use that thumbnail after removal. When false or no library default exists, the stream will have no thumbnail.

404.description: The requested stream was not found or no custom thumbnail is set

get.description: Returns recent generated thumbnail object paths for the specified live stream. You can limit the number of results and optionally constrain by a time range using 'from' and 'to' in UTC.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of thumbnails to return. Default: 5

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter thumbnails created at or after this UTC timestamp

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter thumbnails created at or before this UTC timestamp

200.description: A list of thumbnail object paths (most recent first)

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

get.description: Returns the current status of the specified live stream.

parameters.name: libraryId
parameters.description: The ID of the video library.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the live stream.

200.description: The current status of the live stream

404.description: The requested live stream was not found

primary.description: Bitrate samples for the primary ingest over the requested range, averaged into short fixed-width buckets. Null (not an empty list) if no data was recorded for the primary ingest in that range.

backup.description: Bitrate samples for the backup ingest over the requested range, averaged into short fixed-width buckets. Null (not an empty list) if no data was recorded for the backup ingest in that range.

title.description: The title of the live stream. Required — the request is rejected if left blank.

description.description: The description of the live stream

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the live stream belongs. Must be the ID of an existing collection in this video library.

dvrEnabled.description: Determines if DVR is enabled for the live stream, defaults to the video library setting

dvrWindowSeconds.description: The DVR window size in seconds, required when DvrEnabled is true, max is 12 hours, defaults to the video library setting

recordVod.description: Determines if a VOD recording should be created for the live stream, defaults to the video library setting

streamType.description: The type of the live stream, defaults to Event (0). Channel (1) creates a 24/7 live stream: it never records a VOD, has no maximum publishing duration and stays restartable without a time limit after the publisher disconnects: reconnect with the same stream key. A Channel cannot be combined with RecordVod=true, and can be scheduled like an Event. The type can be changed by an update until the stream starts, while no publisher is connected. RecordVod defaults to false for a Channel, regardless of the video library setting.

autoStartOnIngestDetected.description: Determines if the live stream should start automatically when ingest is detected, defaults to the video library setting. A scheduled stream is not started before its scheduled start time.

scheduledStartTime.description: The scheduled start time of the live stream (optional, UTC). Must be in the future.

scheduledEndTime.description: The scheduled end time of the live stream (optional, UTC). Automatically stops the stream if it is running past that time. Must be in the future and after ScheduledStartTime when both are set. For an Event (0) with a ScheduledStartTime, must be at most 12 hours after it; a Channel (1) has no such limit.

public.description: Determines if the live stream is publicly accessible, defaults to true

enableCountdown.description: Determines if countdown should be shown in player before the stream start, if it was scheduled, defaults to the video library setting. Only usable when ScheduledStartTime is set in this request; the library default is only inherited for scheduled streams, and enabling it on an instant stream is rejected.

outputs.description: A list of outputs that the incoming stream will be forwarded to. If omitted or empty, inherits the outputs configured at the video library level, if any. How many outputs are allowed depends on the account billing standing: fewer during the free trial without a linked payment card. Takes precedence over the deprecated RtmpOutputs when both are sent.

rtmpOutputs.description: Deprecated, replaced by Outputs. Only read when Outputs is omitted.
rtmpOutputs.x-deprecatedMessage: Replaced by Outputs, kept for backwards compatibility.

preStreamTrailerVideoId.description: GUID of an existing, non-deleted video in this library to play before the stream starts. Defaults to the video library's configured trailer video if omitted.

rtmp.description: The ingest endpoints of the live stream to use with RTMP

rtmps.description: The ingest endpoints of the live stream to use with RTMPS

srt.description: The ingest endpoints of the live stream to use with SRT

oneOf.title: Undefined
oneOf.description: Shouldn't be used

oneOf.title: StreamLengthsDifference
oneOf.description: Marks that there is a mismatch between lengths of audio and video streams in the transcoded file

oneOf.title: TranscodingWarnings
oneOf.description: Marks that transcoding completed with warnings

oneOf.title: IncompatibleResolution
oneOf.description: Marks that original video file has incompatible resolution or isn't a video stream

oneOf.title: InvalidFramerate
oneOf.description: Marks that original video file has invalid framerate

oneOf.title: VideoExceededMaxDuration
oneOf.description: Marks that video stream exceeded max duration

oneOf.title: AudioExceededMaxDuration
oneOf.description: Marks that audio stream exceeded max duration

oneOf.title: OriginalCorrupted
oneOf.description: Marks that video file is corrupted and couldn't be processed properly

oneOf.title: TranscriptionFailed
oneOf.description: Marks that video transcription finished with errors and might not be complete

oneOf.title: JitIncompatible
oneOf.description: Marks that video file is not compatible with JIT encoding

oneOf.title: JitFailed
oneOf.description: Marks that video failed JIT encoding

oneOf.title: CaptionGenerationFailed
oneOf.description: Marks that captions generation failed

oneOf.title: UnsupportedFileType
oneOf.description: Marks that the uploaded or fetched file is not video or audio, for example a photo or a document

oneOf.title: LiveNoEncoderCapacity
oneOf.description: Marks that a publish attempt was refused because the ingest region had no free live encoder

oneOf.title: LiveStreamBlocked
oneOf.description: Marks that the live stream was blocked, or a publish attempt was refused because it is blocked

oneOf.title: LiveTooManyIngests
oneOf.description: Marks that a publish attempt was refused because a primary and a backup ingest were already connected

oneOf.title: LiveRegionConflict
oneOf.description: Marks that a publish attempt was refused because its ingest region conflicts with the stream's region

oneOf.title: LivePublishAfterEnd
oneOf.description: Marks that a publish attempt was refused because the live stream had already ended

oneOf.title: LiveMediaStalled
oneOf.description: Marks that the live output stopped advancing while the publisher stayed connected

oneOf.title: LiveEncoderLost
oneOf.description: Marks that the live encoder was lost

oneOf.title: LiveFailedOverToBackup
oneOf.description: Marks that the live stream failed over to its backup ingest

oneOf.title: LiveIngestRejected
oneOf.description: Marks that the ingest disconnected the publisher because publishing was no longer permitted

oneOf.title: LiveIngestTimeout
oneOf.description: Marks that the ingest disconnected a publisher that never sent a usable stream

oneOf.title: LiveMaxDurationReached
oneOf.description: Marks that the live stream was stopped at the maximum publishing duration

oneOf.title: LiveLibraryDisabled
oneOf.description: Marks that the live stream was stopped because its video library can no longer stream

oneOf.title: LiveDisconnectTimeout
oneOf.description: Marks that the live stream was stopped because the publisher did not reconnect in time

totalEncodingSeconds.description: The total number of live encoding seconds in the selected period.

encodingSecondsChart.description: Live encoding seconds over time for the selected period, grouped hourly or daily in UTC.

encodingSecondsByLiveStream.description: Live encoding seconds grouped by live stream ID.

encodingSecondsByVideoCodec.description: Live encoding seconds grouped by output video codec.

encodingSecondsByResolution.description: Live encoding seconds grouped by output resolution.

hourly.description: Indicates whether the chart uses hourly or daily UTC buckets.

total.description: Combined primary and backup live encoding statistics for the selected period.

primary.description: Live encoding statistics for the primary ingest encoder, as assigned by the encoding pipeline for each live stream. This reflects the actual primary/backup ingest role, not which encoder ran longest.

backup.description: Live encoding statistics for the backup ingest encoder(s), as assigned by the encoding pipeline. Zero for live streams that never used backup ingest.

videoLibraryId.description: The ID of the video library that the live stream belongs to

guid.description: The unique ID of the live stream

title.description: The title of the live stream

description.description: The description of the live stream

category.description: The category of the live stream

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the live stream belongs

public.description: Determines if the live stream is publicly accessible

status.description: The status of the live stream. See LiveStreamStatus.

dateCreated.description: The date when the live stream was created

scheduledStartTime.description: The scheduled start time of the live stream (optional)

scheduledEndTime.description: The scheduled end time of the live stream (optional)

startedAt.description: The date and time when the live stream publishing started

endedAt.description: The date and time when the live stream publishing ended

durationSeconds.description: The final duration of the live stream in seconds, set once the stream has ended. Null while the stream is scheduled or running — use the status endpoint's Duration for the live elapsed time.

streamKey.description: The secret key required to authenticate publishing to this stream. Treat as a credential; can be rotated via the regenerate-stream-key endpoint, which immediately invalidates the old value and interrupts an active publisher. Empty for a stream auto-created by publishing with the library's auto-create stream key, which is published with that key.

playbackUrlHls.description: The HLS playback URL of the live stream

dvrEnabled.description: Determines if DVR is enabled for the live stream

dvrWindowSeconds.description: The DVR window size in seconds, required when DvrEnabled is true

recordVod.description: Determines if a VOD recording should be created for the live stream

streamType.description: The type of the live stream: Event (0) is a regular stream, Channel (1) is a 24/7 stream that never records a VOD, has no maximum publishing duration and stays restartable without a time limit after the publisher disconnects. Can be changed by an update until the stream starts, while no publisher is connected.

autoStartOnIngestDetected.description: Determines if the live stream should start automatically when ingest is detected

availableResolutions.description: Comma-separated list of resolution labels that have finished encoding and are ready to play (e.g. "1080p,720p"). Empty or null until the first rendition is available.

width.description: The input video width in pixels

height.description: The input video height in pixels

framerate.description: The framerate of the input stream

peakConcurrentViewers.description: The peak number of concurrent viewers

totalViewerSeconds.description: The total viewer watch time in seconds

thumbnailFileName.description: The file name of the thumbnail inside of the storage

thumbnailUrl.description: The CDN URL of the thumbnail

thumbnailUpdatedAt.description: The date and time when the thumbnail was last updated

enableCountdown.description: Determines if countdown should be shown in player before the stream start, if it was scheduled

outputs.description: A list of outputs that the incoming stream will be forwarded to

rtmpOutputs.description: Deprecated, replaced by Outputs. Carries the same list.
rtmpOutputs.x-deprecatedMessage: Replaced by Outputs, kept for backwards compatibility.

preStreamTrailerVideoId.description: Video ID of the trailer that will be played before the live stream starts

ingestEndpoints.description: The ingest endpoint URLs available for publishing this stream

transcodingMessages.description: Problems the live stream ran into, oldest first: refused publish attempts, blocks, interrupted output, failovers and abnormal stops. Every occurrence is listed, up to the newest 50; a resolved problem stays listed. See TranscodingMessageModel and IssueCodes.

isDisconnected.description: Whether an active stream is waiting for playable live media, including startup and reconnection. False when a live origin is eligible for delivery or the stream is inactive; null when availability cannot be determined.

libraryName.description: The name of the video library.

pullZoneId.description: The pull zone ID backing the video library's CDN delivery.

captionsPath.description: CDN URL of the directory containing the live stream's caption (.vtt) files.

seekPath.description: CDN URL of the directory containing the live stream's seek/scrub thumbnail sprites.

thumbnailUrl.description: CDN URL of the live stream's thumbnail image.

fallbackUrl.description: CDN URL prefix for the live stream's MP4 fallback renditions.

videoPlaylistUrl.description: CDN URL of the live stream's HLS playlist.

previewAuthorized.description: Whether the request carried a valid preview token, so VideoPlaylistUrl points at the stream owner's signed preview path instead of the public playlist.

originalUrl.description: CDN URL of the original ingest source. Only populated when the library allows early/original playback.

previewUrl.description: CDN URL of the live stream's animated preview (scrub thumbnail).

controls.description: Comma-separated list of player control identifiers enabled for this library.

enableDRM.description: Whether DRM protection is enabled for this live stream.

drmVersion.description: DRM protection tier applied to this stream, as an integer cast of the Basic/Enterprise tier enum. Only relevant when EnableDRM is true.

playerKeyColor.description: The player's accent/key color, as a CSS color value.

vastTagUrl.description: VAST ad tag URL used to serve ads in the player; empty when ads are disabled.

viAiPublisherId.description: Publisher ID for the vi.ai advertising integration; ads are enabled in the player when this is non-empty.

captionsFontColor.description: CSS color value for the caption text.

captionsBackground.description: CSS color value for the caption background.

uiLanguage.description: Locale code for the player's UI language (e.g. "en").

allowEarlyPlay.description: Whether the stream can be played from the original ingest source before HLS renditions are ready.

tokenAuthEnabled.description: Whether the library's CDN delivery requires signed URLs for playback assets (segments, manifests, thumbnails, etc.). This is a separate setting from whether this endpoint itself required a token to return data.

enableMP4Fallback.description: Whether MP4 fallback renditions are available for players that cannot use HLS.

showHeatmap.description: Whether the attention heatmap is enabled for this library's player.

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family value used by the player.

playbackSpeeds.description: Comma-separated list of playback speed multipliers offered to the viewer (e.g. "0.5,1,1.5,2").

widevineMinClientSecurityLevel.description: Minimum required Widevine client security level (1-3). Ignored (always null here) when WidevineSdOnlyForL3 is enabled, since that setting takes precedence.

widevineEmeRobustness.description: EME robustness string corresponding to WidevineMinClientSecurityLevel (e.g. "SW_SECURE_CRYPTO", "HW_SECURE_DECODE"); null when no minimum level applies.

widevineSdOnlyForL3.description: When true, Widevine L3 (software-only) clients are capped to SD playback while stronger clients play at full quality; overrides WidevineMinClientSecurityLevel when both are set.

maxSoftwareWidevineResolution.description: Maximum vertical resolution allowed for software (L3) Widevine clients when WidevineSdOnlyForL3 is enabled; null otherwise.

zoneTier.description: Pull zone tier associated with this video library (integer enum value).

rememberPlayerPosition.description: Whether the player resumes from the viewer's last watched position.

customCss.description: Custom CSS injected into the player. Only populated when the caller explicitly requests it.

exposeVideoMetadata.description: Whether JSON-LD structured data (schema.org VideoObject markup) is rendered for this live stream, e.g. for SEO.

enableCompactControls.description: Whether the player uses a compact control bar layout.

playlistUrl.description: CDN URL of the signed preview HLS playlist. It stops working once the stream goes public or the token expires.

playerQueryParameters.description: Query string to add to the player embed URL so it plays the signed preview, without a leading '?'. Includes the view token when the library requires one.

expiresAt.description: When the preview access expires. Request new access after this time.

oneOf.title: Created
oneOf.description: Live stream was just created

oneOf.title: Scheduled
oneOf.description: Live stream was scheduled to start at time set in 'ScheduledStartTime' (UTC). Publishing can be started earlier but stream will be watchable only after this time

oneOf.title: Preview
oneOf.description: Publishing has started but stream was not started from within the dashboard, meaning it can be viewed only from the preview player in dashboard

oneOf.title: Running
oneOf.description: Stream was started from the dashboard, publishing has started and stream is live

oneOf.title: Ended
oneOf.description: Stream was finished and publishing is no longer possible

oneOf.title: VodProcessing
oneOf.description: Stream has ended and is currently processing the VOD output

oneOf.title: Error
oneOf.description: Stream encountered an error during live publishing or ingest

isDisconnected.description: Whether an active stream is waiting for playable live media, including startup and reconnection. False when a live origin is eligible for delivery or the stream is inactive; null when availability cannot be determined.

readyToStart.description: Determines if the stream is ready to start based on live status

primaryLive.description: Determines if the primary ingest is live

backupLive.description: Determines if the backup ingest is live

lastPingAgo.description: The number of milliseconds since the last ping, if available

duration.description: The stream's duration in seconds: the elapsed time so far while it is running, and the final recorded length once it has ended (matching LiveStreamModel.DurationSeconds, falling back to the interval between StartedAt and EndedAt). Null for a stream that never started.

statusTimeUtc.description: The UTC time when the status is read

oneOf.title: Event
oneOf.description: A regular live stream with a start and an end, optionally recorded as a VOD

oneOf.title: Channel
oneOf.description: A 24/7 live stream: it never records a VOD, has no maximum publishing duration and stays restartable without a time limit after the publisher disconnects

totalItems.description: The total number of items across all pages matching the query, not just the current page.

currentPage.description: The current page number of the result set (1-based).

itemsPerPage.description: The effective page size after clamping the requested value; the last page may contain fewer items.

items.description: The items on the current page, in the order returned by the query; an empty list if no results match.

title.description: The title of the live stream, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null or blank.

description.description: The description of the live stream, left unchanged when omitted. Null removes it.

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the live stream belongs, left unchanged when omitted. Null removes the stream from its collection. Must reference an existing collection in this library.

dvrEnabled.description: Determines if DVR is enabled for the live stream, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null.

dvrWindowSeconds.description: The DVR window size in seconds, required when DvrEnabled is true, max is 12 hours, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null.

recordVod.description: Determines if a VOD recording should be created for the live stream, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null.

streamType.description: The type of the live stream: Event (0) or Channel (1), left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null. Can only be changed before the stream has started and while no publisher is connected. Changing to a Channel is rejected while the stream records a VOD: set RecordVod to false first or in the same request.

autoStartOnIngestDetected.description: Determines if the live stream should start automatically when ingest is detected, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null. A scheduled stream is not started before its scheduled start time.

scheduledStartTime.description: The scheduled start time of the live stream (UTC), left unchanged when omitted. If changed, must be in the future. Null removes it before the stream runs: the stream is no longer started automatically, its countdown is disabled, and a Scheduled stream becomes Created, or Preview while a publisher is connected. Cannot be removed while running.

scheduledEndTime.description: The scheduled end time of the live stream (UTC), left unchanged when omitted. Automatically stops the stream if it is running when the scheduled job executes. Can be changed or removed while running. Null removes it, so the stream is no longer stopped automatically. If changed, must be in the future and after the (effective) scheduled start time. For an Event with a scheduled start time, must be at most 12 hours after it.

public.description: Determines if the live stream is publicly accessible, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null.

enableCountdown.description: Determines if countdown should be shown in player before the stream start, if it was scheduled, left unchanged when omitted. Cannot be null. Can only be enabled if the stream has (or is given in the same request) a scheduled start time.

preStreamTrailerVideoId.description: GUID of an existing, non-deleted video in this library to play before the stream starts, left unchanged when omitted. Null removes the trailer.

outputs.description: A list of outputs that the incoming stream will be forwarded to, left unchanged when omitted. This replaces the entire existing list: null or an empty array removes all outputs. How many outputs are allowed depends on the account billing standing: fewer during the free trial without a linked payment card. An unchanged list is always accepted.

videoLibraryId.description: The ID of the video library that the live stream belongs to

guid.description: The unique ID of the live stream

title.description: The title of the live stream

description.description: The description of the live stream

category.description: The category of the live stream

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the live stream belongs

public.description: Determines if the live stream is publicly accessible

status.description: The status of the live stream. See LiveStreamStatus.

dateCreated.description: The date when the live stream was created

scheduledStartTime.description: The scheduled start time of the live stream (optional)

scheduledEndTime.description: The scheduled end time of the live stream (optional)

startedAt.description: The date and time when the live stream publishing started

endedAt.description: The date and time when the live stream publishing ended

durationSeconds.description: The final duration of the live stream in seconds, set once the stream has ended. Null while the stream is scheduled or running — use the status endpoint's Duration for the live elapsed time.

playbackUrlHls.description: The HLS playback URL of the live stream

dvrEnabled.description: Determines if DVR is enabled for the live stream

dvrWindowSeconds.description: The DVR window size in seconds, required when DvrEnabled is true

recordVod.description: Determines if a VOD recording should be created for the live stream

streamType.description: The type of the live stream: Event (0) is a regular stream, Channel (1) is a 24/7 stream that never records a VOD, has no maximum publishing duration and stays restartable without a time limit after the publisher disconnects. Can be changed by an update until the stream starts, while no publisher is connected.

autoStartOnIngestDetected.description: Determines if the live stream should start automatically when ingest is detected

availableResolutions.description: Comma-separated list of resolution labels that have finished encoding and are ready to play (e.g. "1080p,720p"). Empty or null until the first rendition is available.

width.description: The input video width in pixels

height.description: The input video height in pixels

framerate.description: The framerate of the input stream

peakConcurrentViewers.description: The peak number of concurrent viewers

totalViewerSeconds.description: The total viewer watch time in seconds

thumbnailFileName.description: The file name of the thumbnail inside of the storage

thumbnailUrl.description: The CDN URL of the thumbnail

thumbnailUpdatedAt.description: The date and time when the thumbnail was last updated

enableCountdown.description: Determines if countdown should be shown in player before the stream start, if it was scheduled

preStreamTrailerVideoId.description: Video ID of the trailer that will be played before the live stream starts

value.description: The bitrate value for this sample, in kilobits per second (kbps).

primaryIngestUrl.description: The primary ingest URL of the live stream, combine with StreamKey to create the full ingest URL

backupIngestUrl.description: The backup ingest URL of the live stream, combine with StreamKey to create the full ingest URL

streamKey.description: The stream key to append to the RTMP output endpoint URL when forwarding the stream.

oneOf.title: Undefined
oneOf.description: Shouldn't be used

oneOf.title: Information
oneOf.description: An info message to the user, shouldn't break anythying

oneOf.title: Warning
oneOf.description: A warning message, for example that the transcoded video may break when playing

oneOf.title: Error
oneOf.description: An error, meaning that the video will most likely not be playable

primaryIngestUrl.description: The full primary ingest URL of the live stream, including the StreamKey

backupIngestUrl.description: The full backup ingest URL of the live stream, including the StreamKey

success.description: Determines if the request was successful

message.description: Human-readable message describing the result, typically populated with error details when Success is false.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code corresponding to the result of the request.

data.description: The response payload. Some endpoints also populate this with error details when Success is false — see the endpoint's own response documentation.

url.description: The storage-relative object path of the thumbnail (not a full URL) — prepend the pull zone hostname to build a playable URL.

timestamp.description: UTC time the thumbnail was created. Results are returned most-recent-first.

timeStamp.description: Date and time when this message was added (UTC).

issueCode.description: Issue code identifying the specific transcoding problem. See IssueCodes.

value.description: Additional context value for the issue, if applicable; otherwise empty.

title.description: The title of the live stream. Required on every update request, even one that only changes other fields — the request is rejected if left blank.

description.description: The description of the live stream

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the live stream belongs. Omit/null to leave the current collection unchanged; send an empty string to remove the stream from its collection. Must reference an existing collection in this library.

dvrEnabled.description: Determines if DVR is enabled for the live stream, left unchanged when omitted

dvrWindowSeconds.description: The DVR window size in seconds, required when DvrEnabled is true, max is 12 hours, left unchanged when omitted

recordVod.description: Determines if a VOD recording should be created for the live stream, left unchanged when omitted

streamType.description: The type of the live stream: Event (0) or Channel (1), left unchanged when omitted. Can only be changed before the stream has started and while no publisher is connected. Changing to a Channel is rejected while the stream records a VOD: set RecordVod to false first or in the same request.

autoStartOnIngestDetected.description: Determines if the live stream should start automatically when ingest is detected, left unchanged when omitted. A scheduled stream is not started before its scheduled start time.

scheduledStartTime.description: The scheduled start time of the live stream (optional, UTC). If changed, must be in the future.

scheduledEndTime.description: The scheduled end time of the live stream (optional, UTC). Automatically stops the stream if it is running when the scheduled job executes. Can be changed while running. If changed, must be in the future and after the (effective) scheduled start time. Omit/null to leave unchanged.

public.description: Determines if the live stream is publicly accessible, left unchanged when omitted

enableCountdown.description: Determines if countdown should be shown in player before the stream start, if it was scheduled, left unchanged when omitted. Can only be enabled if the stream has (or is given in the same request) a scheduled start time.

preStreamTrailerVideoId.description: GUID of an existing, non-deleted video in this library to play before the stream starts. Omit/null to leave the current trailer unchanged; send an empty string to remove it.

outputs.description: A list of outputs that the incoming stream will be forwarded to. This replaces the entire existing list: omit/null to leave outputs unchanged, or send an empty array to remove all outputs. How many outputs are allowed depends on the account billing standing: fewer during the free trial without a linked payment card. An unchanged list is always accepted. Takes precedence over the deprecated RtmpOutputs when both are sent.

rtmpOutputs.description: Deprecated, replaced by Outputs. Only read when Outputs is omitted.
rtmpOutputs.x-deprecatedMessage: Replaced by Outputs, kept for backwards compatibility.
